verdict.rationale: A dedicated llms.txt returns 404, but probes show docs are available in plain markdown form (docs.md returns HTTP 200), which an agent could fetch and parse similarly to an agent-oriented doc format. This is a partial, non-standard substitute rather than a true llms.txt or explicit agent-doc offering. Missing for 10: an actual llms.txt file, explicit agent-facing documentation index, or vendor statements about agent consumability of docs.
